answer: Because the dune forfeiture is applied at exit, the nebula ledger totals each burn, and the onyx audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 101 aliases thus destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 82% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned so that nobody profits from it. That is 11 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
